question: Bratia Liam a Noel Gallagher sa v roku 2025 po šestnástich rokoch odmlky opäť spolu postavili na pódium na veľkom turné. Ktorú kapelu tým oživili?
source_excerpt: Oasis plays first show in 16 years, thrilling fans in Cardiff tour kickoff

extra.why_interesting: The famously feuding brothers everyone thought would never share a stage again did exactly that; the player just has to connect the Gallagher name to the band.

topicality.rationale: Oasis reunion tour was a major 2025 headline, still remembered but over a year old.

extra.verification_notes: Oasis reunited for the Live '25 tour, opening in Cardiff on 4 July 2025, 16 years after the 2009 split; I found nothing newer that contradicts this.

explanation: Oasis sa rozpadli v roku 2009 po hádke bratov v zákulisí a turné Oasis Live '25 odštartovalo v júli 2025 v Cardiffe.

question: Ryan Gosling hrá vo filme Project Hail Mary z marca 2026 vedca, ktorý sa prebudí sám na vesmírnej lodi. Predloha je od autora, podľa ktorého knihy vznikol aj slávny film s Mattom Damonom o preživšom na Marse. Ako sa ten starší film volá?
source_excerpt: Ryan Gosling space adventure ... March 20, 2026 release date ... Weir is also a producer

extra.why_interesting: Players may not know the author's name, but the setup (lone scientist stranded in space, humour, science) points straight at The Martian.

topicality.rationale: Answer is The Martian (2015); the new film is only context.

extra.verification_notes: Project Hail Mary (Mar 2026, Gosling) is by Andy Weir, who also wrote The Martian (2015, Matt Damon), titled 'Marťan' in Slovak; see https://www.thewrap.com/project-hail-mary-release-date-cast-plot/

explanation: Obidve knihy napísal Andy Weir, a Marťan s Mattom Damonom nakrútil v roku 2015 Ridley Scott.

question: Samurajská hra Ghost of Yōtei z októbra 2025, nástupkyňa Ghost of Tsushima, nesie meno podľa sopky na najsevernejšom z veľkých japonských ostrovov. Na ktorom ostrove sa odohráva?

extra.why_interesting: Players expect a samurai game to be set on the main island; the clue that Yōtei is a mountain in the far north lets a thoughtful player reason to the answer.

topicality.rationale: Major game release from October 2025, topical for a season.

extra.verification_notes: Wikipedia confirms the game is set in 1603 Ezo, the island now known as Hokkaido, and was released 2 Oct 2025; later releases don't change this.

explanation: Hra sa odohráva v roku 1603 na vtedajšom Ezo, dnešnom Hokkaide, kde hrdinka Atsu stíha gang, ktorý jej zničil rodinu.
